title: AgentOffer Query Response Schema v1.0
description: Adopted conversational Offer Query response with optional explanation and next-step guidance.

request_id.description: Correlation identifier for this Query response. It matches the request_id supplied or assigned for the Query request.

protocol_version.description: Transport protocol line used to produce this response. It is distinct from offers[].version, which is the Offer document-model lineage.

language.description: Language selected for user-facing response content under the stable-v1.0 language-tag profile. It does not itself express user eligibility or Partner targeting.

offers.description: Public Offer projections in descending selection order for this Query. Earlier entries have higher selection priority under the producer's declared matching policy; order is not stable or comparable across separate requests. When empty, empty_reason is required.

engagement.description: Optional user-facing suggestions for refining the current intent or exploring an adjacent topic. It does not change the returned Offer payloads.

hooks.description: Optional non-empty change cues comparing one returned Offer with an explicit previous Query baseline. Hooks are response content, not callback registrations, watch state, or delivery guarantees.

empty_reason.description: Required primary explanation for an empty offers array and omitted otherwise. When several causes apply, precedence is consent_missing, scene_suppressed, frequency_capped, no_material, then below_relevance_threshold.

offers.description: Conditional branch that identifies an empty Offer result.
Conditional branch that identifies a non-empty Offer result.

engagement.description: Optional non-empty guidance that helps the user continue the current decision journey.

refinements.description: Non-empty suggestions that narrow or clarify the current Query intent.

followup_topics.description: Non-empty adjacent-topic suggestions ordered by descending confidence within this response.

refinement.description: One user-facing suggestion for narrowing the current Query.

label.description: Short user-facing label for the refinement.

query_helper.description: Structured request patch to apply if the user selects the refinement.

speak.description: Optional non-empty longer phrasing suitable for voice or conversational presentation.

followupTopic.description: One user-facing suggestion for exploring a related topic.

label.description: Short user-facing label for the related topic.

basis.description: Declared relationship between the follow-up topic and the current Query; each value has a normative definition in the field-semantics glossary.

query_helper.description: Structured non-destructive partial update to apply if the user selects the follow-up topic.

confidence.description: Producer-normalized relevance estimate for this follow-up. Values are comparable only among followup_topics in this response, are ordered descending, and are neither calibrated probabilities nor cross-producer scores.

queryHelper.description: Structured and bounded instruction for deriving a subsequent Query without deleting current request fields.

request_patch.description: Non-null, non-empty partial update limited to intent.signals and category constraints. Every supplied nested object contains an actual update. Omission preserves the current value, objects merge recursively, arrays replace the prior array, and explicit current-turn user conditions win on conflict.

intent.description: Permitted intent portion of the next-Query update; when present it contains non-empty signals.

signals.description: Non-empty, non-null intent signals proposed for the next Query; omitted members remain unchanged.

constraints.description: Non-empty object of non-null replacement arrays for permitted category constraints; omitted members remain unchanged. An empty supplied array is meaningful and clears that constraint list.

origin.description: Optional non-empty, bounded provenance references for the suggested next Query.

hook.description: One user-facing change cue for a returned Offer compared with an explicit prior Query response.

kind.description: Category of changed Offer information; each value has a normative definition in the field-semantics glossary.

title.description: Short user-facing title for the change cue.

description.description: Optional user-facing explanation of the observed change.

subject_offer_id.description: offer_id of the returned Offer whose current representation is being compared.

baseline_request_id.description: request_id of the prior Query response used as the comparison baseline; it must match context.session.previous_request_id from the current request.

query_helper.description: Optional structured next-Query update associated with the change cue.
